test_name: System and Services Acquisition - SA-11 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Operations-Console-167
Primary NIST family: System and Services Acquisition (SA); evidence focus: SA-11.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: developer security testing produces retained evidence and verified flaw remediation. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
